genome.name: ivy
genome.strategy: Start from the base rate: how often do events of this exact kind happen? Only move away from that number for specific, concrete evidence.

genome.name: oak
genome.strategy: The status quo usually wins. Things change more slowly than people expect, and most deadlines pass with nothing happening.

genome.name: elm
genome.strategy: Read the resolution rules like a lawyer. Work out exactly what must happen, by exactly when, and how many separate things must all go right.

genome.name: ash
genome.strategy: Follow the incentives. Ask who wants this outcome, who can make it happen, and what it would cost them.

genome.name: fir
genome.strategy: Think like a calibrated superforecaster. Split the question into parts, estimate each one, and combine them. Avoid certainty.
